name: Wake listener
author: Brett
description: An always-on wake-word listener for the console and the console Android app: say a wake phrase Brett sets in Settings (several allowed), then a command. Runs on-device (the console app's offline recognizer through the native bridge; the browser's recognizer elsewhere) with a mic-on light on the banner and an off switch. Every console action, plugin command, control@1 target and pipeline command has a voice entry built from the API registry (new plugins appear by themselves); a command with missing fields runs as a spoken wizard ('create a new project' → 'name?' → 'Gizmo Johnson' → confirm). 'Approve' reviews everything waiting on axHub one at a time (approve / deny / skip / approve all pending). REST /api/plugins/wake-listener (settings, on, off, state, catalog, match), MCP wake-listener_*, CLI listener.mjs / axf wake-listener, voice.

items.title: The wake listener's settings (on, wake phrases, engine, timings, replies, indicator)
items.description: Reads the listener's settings: the switch, the wake phrases, which engine listens (auto, the phone's native recognizer, the browser's speech recognition or off), how long it stays awake and waits for an answer, spoken replies, the chime, the banner mic light and pausing while the console is hidden.

items.title: Change the wake listener's settings; addPhrase / removePhrase add or drop one wake phrase
items.description: Changes any of the listener's settings in one call; addPhrase and removePhrase edit the wake phrase list one phrase at a time instead of replacing it.

items.title: Switch the wake listener on (the open console starts listening)
items.description: Turns the listener on: every open console takes the microphone lease and listens for a wake phrase.

items.title: Switch the wake listener off (the mic closes)
items.description: Turns the listener off everywhere: the microphone closes and the banner mic light goes grey.

items.title: What the listener is doing now: phase, engine, mic open, last heard, last command, last reply
items.description: Reads what the listener is doing right now: its phase (off, waiting, awake, in a wizard or approvals review), the engine, whether the mic is open, and the last phrase heard, command run and reply spoken.

items.skip: the open console's own state report

items.title: The voice command catalog: every console action, plugin command, control@1 target and pipeline command with its spoken forms and fields
items.description: Lists every voice command the listener understands, built from the console's actions, plugin commands, control@1 targets and pipeline commands, with the spoken forms and the fields each one takes.

items.title: Dry run a phrase against the catalog: the entry it lands on, the fields it filled, the ones a wizard would ask
items.description: Tests a phrase without running anything: which catalog entry it would land on, the fields it filled from the words, and the ones a spoken wizard would still ask for.

items.title: Say a phrase to the open console as if the mic heard it (the wake phrase is optional): runs the command, answers a wizard or reviews approvals
items.description: Feeds a phrase to the open console as if the microphone heard it, so REST, MCP, the CLI and tests drive the same path as voice: it runs the command, answers the wizard that is waiting, or reviews approvals.

items.title: Start the spoken approvals review in the open console: each call waiting on axHub, one at a time (approve / deny / skip / approve all pending)
items.description: Starts the spoken approvals review in the open console: each call waiting on axHub is read out in turn and answered with approve, deny, skip or approve all pending.

items.title: Start a spoken wizard for a catalog entry in the open console (args = the entry id, e.g. project-wizard/run)
items.description: Starts a spoken wizard for one catalog entry in the open console: it asks for each missing field by voice, then runs the command.

items.title: Stop the wizard or approvals review that has the floor
items.description: Ends the spoken wizard or approvals review that has the floor; the listener goes back to waiting for its wake phrase.

items.title: Switch the listener on from the open console
items.description: Console action that switches the listener on from the open console (voice, the command palette, the API).

items.title: Switch the listener off from the open console
items.description: Console action that switches the listener off from the open console; the microphone closes.

items.title: Flip the listener switch
items.description: Flips the listener switch: on when it is off, off when it is on.

items.title: Open the wake listener's settings tab
items.description: Opens the wake listener's settings tab under Settings, Plugins.
